description.value:
Cost: 6,000eb
Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)

Neuralware. Borgware. Requires 2 Neuralware Option Slots and 2 Internal Option Slot.
Duration: 5 rounds (15 seconds)
Primary Effects:
+4 to Initiative.
+1 to Evasion.
+2 to Perception.
Secondary Effects (Limit 2 per Round):
Bonus to Initiative is increased to +5 until the end of user's next turn.
User may perform any of the following Actions as half of a ROF 2 Action: Equip/Drop Shield, Get Up, Reload, Stabilize (yourself only), and any Action taken to activate an item or cyberware, clear a jam, put yourself out while On Fire, or stow a weapon. None of these ROF 2 Actions can be taken twice in one Turn
User can perform an Action that usually takes up to 1 minute with a single Action. Conditional, mostly for technical stuff?)

Note: Activating the Uzushio causes the user to suffer 1d6 Humanity Loss. The Uzushio may only be safely activated once per hour. Each time the Sandevistan is activated again before an hour can pass, the humanity loss is doubled, to 2d6, then 4d6, etc. until an hour is allowed to pass. Using any of the Secondary Effects will cause the user to suffer 3 Humanity Loss each time they are used.

Type: Neuralware
Option Slots: uses 2

Foundry notes:

  • Activate it like the core Sandevistan: the Primary Effects are toggles in the roll dialog, on by default, and the Secondary Effects are toggles that start off. Turn on only the ones you use.
  • It also needs 2 Internal Option Slots.
  • The ROF 2 Actions and one-Action tasks are not automated. One Secondary Effect line in the sheet is unfinished ("Conditional, mostly for technical stuff?)").
  • Humanity Loss for activating it and for each Secondary Effect is not automated.
  • The sheet gives no install location, so it uses the core Sandevistan's (Clinic).

From Bontari Homebrew Cyberpunk Items by Bontari (Sandevistans).
